en.summary: Corrects the CSR number used for the local-memory-base register, fixing the hardware-visible decode point for reading LMEM base.
why_it_counts: The patch changes a hardware/software interface constant that controls which CSR address returns LMEM_BASE_ADDR.
The constant is consumed by RTL CSR decode in hw/rtl/core/VX_csr_data.sv.
The change is a focused control-address fix, not a feature addition or cleanup.
disqualifiers: The commit message is generic and the patch is only one line, so intent must be inferred from surrounding code.
evidence: In the same tree, hw/rtl/core/VX_csr_data.sv returns LMEM_BASE_ADDR when VX_CSR_LOCAL_MEM_BASE is decoded.
The same CSR symbol is referenced by kernel/include/vx_spawn.h and sim/simx/emulator.cpp, confirming it is an architectural interface point.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A control-status register interface depends on exact numeric decode constants. If a read-only capability register is assigned the wrong CSR number, software that probes the documented address reads the wrong location, while the hardware exposes valid information at an unintended address.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: CSR address decode for a hardware capability register
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Software, firmware, or a runtime library reads the CSR that should report the local scratchpad or local-memory base address.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Move the CSR decode for the local-memory-base register to the wrong numeric slot, typically a neighboring or stale constant.
portability_notes: This maps to any DUT that exposes implementation parameters through CSRs or memory-mapped status registers.
The bug can be injected either at the symbolic constant definition or directly in the decode table.
The effect is architectural even if the returned data path itself is otherwise correct.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the decode entry that returns the local-memory-base or scratchpad-base value.
Change its address constant to the old or neighboring CSR value without changing the returned payload.
Leave software expectations unchanged so the documented CSR address no longer matches the hardware decode.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSR number definition for VX_CSR_LOCAL_MEM_BASE, consumed by VX_csr_data
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes VX_CSR_LOCAL_MEM_BASE from 12'hFC3 to 12'hFC4.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert the CSR macro in hw/rtl/VX_types.vh back to 12'hFC3 so the local-memory-base read decodes at the old address.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Reads of the documented local-memory-base CSR return the wrong register value or no value, while the actual base address is exposed at a different CSR number.
evidence_for_injection: The patch changes only the decode constant, not the returned data source.
Software and simulator code in the same tree reference the same CSR symbol, so a decode mismatch is architecturally visible.
notes: This is a small but reusable injection: mis-number a hardware-visible status register.
Because the patch is only one line, confidence is medium rather than high.

zh.summary: 该提交修正了本地内存基址寄存器使用的 CSR 编号，修复了读取 LMEM 基址时对外可见的硬件解码位置。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了一个硬件/软件接口常量，该常量决定哪个 CSR 地址会返回 LMEM_BASE_ADDR。
该常量会被 hw/rtl/core/VX_csr_data.sv 中的 RTL CSR 解码逻辑使用。
这是一个聚焦的控制地址修复，而不是功能新增或清理。
disqualifiers: 提交信息很笼统，而且补丁只有一行，因此需要结合周边代码推断其意图。
evidence: 在同一代码树中，hw/rtl/core/VX_csr_data.sv 会在解码到 VX_CSR_LOCAL_MEM_BASE 时返回 LMEM_BASE_ADDR。
同一个 CSR 符号还被 kernel/include/vx_spawn.h 和 sim/simx/emulator.cpp 引用，说明它是体系结构接口的一部分。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 控制状态寄存器接口依赖精确的数值解码常量。如果一个只读能力寄存器被分配到了错误的 CSR 编号，软件去读取文档规定地址时就会命中错误位置，而硬件会在另一个非预期地址暴露本来正确的数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 硬件能力寄存器的 CSR 地址解码
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 软件、固件或运行时库读取本应报告本地 scratchpad 或本地内存基址的 CSR。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把本地内存基址寄存器的 CSR 解码移动到错误的数值槽位，通常是相邻编号或旧编号。
portability_notes: 该缺陷可映射到任何通过 CSR 或内存映射状态寄存器暴露实现参数的 DUT。
可以在符号常量定义处注入，也可以直接在解码表中注入。
即使返回数据路径本身正确，这个缺陷依然是体系结构可见的。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到返回本地内存基址或 scratchpad 基址的解码项。
在不改动返回数据载荷的前提下，把它的地址常量改成旧值或相邻 CSR 编号。
保持软件侧期望不变，这样文档中的 CSR 地址就不再与硬件解码一致。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_CSR_LOCAL_MEM_BASE 的 CSR 编号定义，由 VX_csr_data 消费
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复把 VX_CSR_LOCAL_MEM_BASE 从 12'hFC3 改为 12'hFC4。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 hw/rtl/VX_types.vh 中的 CSR 宏改回 12'hFC3，使本地内存基址读取重新在旧地址上解码。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 读取文档规定的本地内存基址 CSR 时会得到错误寄存器值或无效值，而真正的基址会出现在另一个 CSR 编号上。
evidence_for_injection: VX_csr_data 把 VX_CSR_LOCAL_MEM_BASE 映射到 LMEM_BASE_ADDR。
该补丁只修改了解码常量，没有改动返回数据源。
同一代码树中的软件和模拟器代码引用了相同的 CSR 符号，因此解码不匹配会在体系结构层面可见。
notes: 这是一个小而可复用的注入类型：把对外可见的状态寄存器编号设错。
由于补丁只有一行，置信度保持为 medium 而不是 high。
